# Vendored libraries

Header-only, MIT licensed, unmodified upstream release files. Only `src/CortexChatClient.cpp` includes them.

| File | Upstream | Version |
|---|---|---|
| `httplib.h` | https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib | v0.62.0 |
| `json.hpp` | https://github.com/nlohmann/json (release asset `json.hpp`) | v3.12.0 |

To update: download the release file over the old one and change the version here.
